findings.claim: Class factory references the RGFirstPersonCharacter UTF-16LE string and the native-registration wrapper.
Registration wrapper traverses eight name/function-pointer pairs starting at 0x148f20250.
GetRagdollTransform copies a 96-byte character state into its return storage.
IsRagdolling obtains a reflected function and dispatches it through a virtual call; its output is boolean.
OnRep_ReplicatedBoneState forwards a decoded parameter to a virtual handler.
Applying appearance to the existing pawn is a useful first prototype; native state, vehicle handling and ragdoll should remain with the game.
Active mesh/skin selection, executed Blueprint material flow, animation and ragdoll compatibility in game remain unobserved.

limitations: This is targeted import and explicit disassembly, not full default Ghidra auto-analysis.
The bridge ping analysis_complete flag means no timeout occurred; it does not turn -noanalysis into whole-program analysis.
C++ types and indirect targets are inferred or unresolved. Some decompilations include shared tail-call helpers beyond the wrapper address set.

The original MCP launch failed because procps could not inspect its own process in the host namespace. Direct Ghidra CLI and the published authenticated read-only REA bridge were used successfully instead.
No Blueprint bytecode or unversioned property value decoding was performed.
No native offsets or executable patches are used by the prototype.
Engine exact patch version was not recovered from the examined version-resource payload or bounded string candidates.
